text: The paper reports that an outcome reward model trained only on outcome supervision of easy (Introductory) APPS problems significantly improves best-of-N performance of SFT-trained Code Llama on hard (Interview and Competition) problems, which the authors take to extend easy-to-hard generalization beyond mathematical reasoning.
title: Easy-trained outcome reward model improves best-of-N on hard APPS coding problems
